title: Tari L1 Web Wallet
summary: Browser wallet for Tari L1 and Ootle accounts, with local WebAssembly signing described by the creator. Burning XTM is irreversible.
cardSummary: Manage Tari L1 and Ootle accounts in a browser wallet; burning XTM is irreversible.
reviewNote: November 19, 2026: the public landing page offers Tari L1 MainNet and Esmeralda wallet creation or import. Current repository revision 2277575fb0f2 maps Ootle accounts to mainnet or Esmeralda, while its README retains pre-launch wording. Source configuration does not establish which Ootle version is deployed or successful mainnet burn claims. Original creator examples describe Esmeralda. CPAL-1.0 source; no wallet creation, import or transaction was performed.
